children: CPI Card Group announced the closing of a public offering of 2,337,323 common shares by selling stockholders, with underwriters exercising their full option for an additional 350,598 shares.
Underwriting agreement executed Sept. 10, 2026 for 2,337,323 shares sold by Tricor Pacific Capital Partners funds.
Underwriters had a 30-day option for 350,598 additional shares and exercised it in full on Sept. 11, 2026.
Offering conducted under Company’s Form S-3 shelf (File No. 333-259511) with prospectus supplement dated Sept. 10, 2026.
Offering closed Sept. 14, 2026; CPI Card Group did not sell shares and will receive no proceeds from the sale.
